name: UN:LOGICAL
source:
"UN:LOGICAL" is a virtual reality game that can only be played by invitation.

In this virtual world—where touch, taste, and pain feel real—adorable "apprentice angels" are said to welcome players as NPCs.

However, those who join for the reward money soon find themselves threatened by the "side effects" caused by the game.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2024/10/licobits-announces-otome-visual-novel-unlogical-for-switch%5D]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
《UN:LOGICAL》是一款仅限受邀者参与的虚拟现实游戏。

在这个触觉、味觉乃至痛觉都无比真实的虚拟世界中，据说会有可爱的“见习天使”以NPC的身份迎接各位玩家。

然而，那些冲着丰厚奖金而参加游戏的人，很快便发现自己正面临着这款游戏所引发的“副作用”的威胁。

[摘自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2024/10/licobits-announces-otome-visual-novel-unlogical-for-switch%5D]Gematsu[/url]]
